tools.description: Find presigned URLs and access tokens in caller-supplied operations that do not state a lifetime, and sentences that both expire and never expire. tools.name: agent-contracts_idempotency-audit
tools.description: Find create or update sentences that do not name an idempotency key or a replay result. The check does not call an operation idempotent unless the supplied text says so, and POST alone is not proof of a write. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/agent-contracts/idempotency-audit. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "agent-contracts" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: agent-contracts_expiry-contract-check, agent-contracts_retry-safety-check, agent-contracts_idempotency-audit, agent-contracts_pagination-contract-check, agent-contracts_error-recovery-audit, agent-contracts_output-contract-check, agent-contracts_state-transition-check, agent-contracts_partial-failure-check · Private data: agent-contracts_expiry-contract-check, agent-contracts_output-contract-check · Public sink: agent-contracts_expiry-contract-check, agent-contracts_retry-safety-check, agent-contracts_idempotency-audit, agent-contracts_pagination-contract-check, agent-contracts_error-recovery-audit, agent-contracts_output-contract-check, agent-contracts_state-transition-check, agent-contracts_partial-failure-check · Destructive: agent-contracts_expiry-contract-check, agent-contracts_retry-safety-check, agent-contracts_idempotency-audit, agent-contracts_pagination-contract-check, agent-contracts_error-recovery-audit, agent-contracts_output-contract-check, agent-contracts_state-transition-check, agent-contracts_partial-failure-check.
